variants.description: Congruently melting composition, the standard commercial crystal.
variants.name: Congruent LiNbO3 (CLN)

variants.description: Lithium tantalate, the 3m sibling crystal of LiNbO3; commercial SAW-grade crystal as measured in kushibiki1999 (composition not recorded in the research notes).
variants.name: LiTaO3, SAW-grade (comparison material)

variants.description: Lithium tantalate where the source does not state the composition (bulk 1965 crystal, or thin film).
variants.name: LiTaO3, composition not stated (comparison material)

variants.description: Stoichiometric LiNbO3 doped with 1 mol% MgO, as labelled in gayer2008 Table 1.
variants.name: 1 mol% MgO-doped stoichiometric LiNbO3 (MgO1-SLN)

variants.description: Congruent LiNbO3 doped with 5 mol% MgO, above the photorefractive threshold (>= 4.5 at.% MgO, bryan1984).
variants.name: 5 mol% MgO-doped congruent LiNbO3 (MgO5)

variants.description: Li2O content close to 50 mol%; values labelled near-SLN in volk2008 are stored here.
variants.name: Stoichiometric or near-stoichiometric LiNbO3 (SLN)

variants.description: The source does not state the composition (for example 1960s crystals or density used in a cell-volume calculation).
variants.name: Composition not stated
